nodes.statement: Restricted theorem lane active: HC-R021-A8-CM4-C2 is selected; construct cycles for every allowed codimension-two rational Hodge class on C_CM4.
Fix the Markman genus-four real-multiplication source datum, associated degree-four CM field, and nonempty Weil-type deformation component.
Restrict to the Hodge-generic locus where Hdg^4 is generated by divisor products plus HW; construct the divisor-product preimage for every allowed alpha.
Construct coherent B-secant sheaves satisfying the source hypotheses.
Prove the Fourier-Mukai/Orlov object has nonzero rank.
Prove the normalized class kappa(E) remains of Hodge type under the relevant Weil-type deformations.
Prove kappa_2(E) has a nonzero projection to HW.
If the semiregularity map is injective on the image of the ambient evaluation/Atiyah map, then every first-order Hodge-preserving ambient obstruction in that image vanishes.

Familywise Perry reduction: on any bound smooth proper CM/Weil family S carrying the global Hodge-persistent flat class kappa(E_0), weak G-semiregularity plus Ext<0=0 lets Perry Theorem 1.2 make kappa algebraic on every fiber of S.

For any finite translation subgroup H, the orbit sum of a coherent/perfect secant object has a canonical H-linearization and Chern character |H| times the original; therefore finite-equivariant representatives on the same secant ray are available without changing the cohomological criterion.

For the explicit-source second-factor gluing family with ch(F)=N[D-(q/6)H^3], Riemann-Roch and Khovanskii-Teissier give ext^2(F,F)>=8qN^2-2; hence ordinary semiregularity is impossible when qN^2>=4 because the degree-two semiregularity target has dimension 28.
Restricted semiregularity on Im(ob_F) is equivalent to ker(ob_F)=ker((bullet) contraction ch(F)); compatibility always gives the inclusion ker(ob_F) subset ker(contraction).
For beta-prime=g^*Theta-(q/6)(g^-1)^*(Theta^3) in the quadratic real-multiplication source datum, the exact HKR contraction map HT^2(X)->H_Omega^{-2}(X) has rank 20 and kernel dimension 8.

Objectwise eight-relation criterion: for any admissible Example 11.2.7 object E with ch(E)=N beta-prime, rank(ob_E)=20 iff the eight explicit generators k1,...,k8 of ker(contraction beta-prime) all vanish under ev_E in Ext^2(E,E). Any one nonzero relation refutes that object.

Example 11.2.7 specifies an admissible gluing family rather than one canonical E-prime; equality of Chern characters fixes sigma_E composed with ob_E but does not determine the object-specific obstruction map or the eight Yoneda classes.

Make Route A object-exact: either bind one concrete admissible gluing datum E-prime-star sufficient to reconstruct its gluing triangle, or prove the eight L007 Yoneda relations uniformly on a stated nonempty open subset of the admissible gluing family.

For the object or generic family bound at A0, evaluate the eight L007 Yoneda relations and compute rank(ob_E). Compatibility forces 20<=rank(ob_E)<=28; the restricted semiregularity condition holds exactly at rank 20.

If P4-A1 closes positively, prove that every successive family obstruction lies in the ambient-obstruction image controlled by restricted semiregularity, yielding an all-orders transport theorem without full semiregularity.

Choose a finite-equivariant representative of the first genus-four secant Chern-character ray; Markman Example 8.2.3 supplies a geometric cyclic-equivariant candidate and L003 supplies an orbit-equivariant replacement in general.
Construct a finite-equivariant representative on the beta-prime ray of Markman Example 11.2.7 without changing the nonzero-Weil-projection criterion.

Find a useful finite symmetry and prove weak equivariant semiregularity of the external-product object or directly of its Fourier-Mukai image, including control of the mixed Ext^1 tensor Ext^1 contribution. Mere orbit equivariance is insufficient.
Transport the finite symmetry through the Orlov/Fourier-Mukai equivalence into A_0 x A_0^vee.
Apply Perry Theorem 1.2 familywise to B_0=-c_1(E_0)/rank(E_0) and w_0=kappa(E_0).

Bind the abstract C_CM4 target quantifier to explicit connected smooth proper algebraic family or level-moduli carriers on which Markman's flat class is a global Hodge section; record coverage/overlap needed to reach every target point.
All-orders algebraicity-transport bridge. Route A now begins with object-exact A0, then rank-20 A1 and all-orders A2. Route G requires weak equivariant semiregularity plus family coverage.
Produce one nonzero algebraic Weil class on every A in C_CM4.
Use algebraic K-endomorphism correspondences to generate every class in HW(A,eta).
Combine divisor-product and Weil preimages to construct z in CH^2(A) tensor Q for arbitrary alpha in Hdg^4(A,Q).
Universal rational cycle-class surjectivity remains outside this restricted tranche.

forbidden_shortcuts: Assume algebraicity of inverse Lefschetz correspondences or Kunneth projectors without an independent theorem.
Replace rational projective Hodge by the false integral or unrestricted compact-Kahler analogue.
Treat persistence of kappa(E) as a Hodge class as algebraicity transport without semiregularity or an equivalent deformation theorem.
Treat finite equivariance, linearization, or orbit averaging as weak G-semiregularity without proving semiregularity in the invariant category.
Infer semiregularity of an external product from factorwise degree-two injectivity without controlling the mixed Ext^1 tensor Ext^1 summand.
Treat restricted first-order semiregularity on Im(ob_F) as an all-orders deformation theorem without proving obstruction-image stability for successive liftings.
Reverse the kernel inclusion ker(ob_F) subset ker(contraction): L006 implies rank(ob_F)>=20, and an admissible object succeeds exactly at the minimal rank 20; a larger rank is failure.
Treat the common Chern character N beta-prime as if it determined the object-specific obstruction map: Example 11.2.7 leaves the curve, translates, line bundle, and gluing isomorphisms unbound.
Apply a familywise Perry theorem to the entire abstract period-domain component without binding an algebraic family/moduli carrier and a global flat Hodge section.
Promote a theorem on the Hodge-generic locus to special fibers carrying additional Hodge classes.
Treat numerical, Tate, absolute-Hodge, or motivated evidence as an algebraic-cycle construction.
claim_boundary: HC-R021-A8-CM4-C2 is selected but unproved. L001-L008 are Solve-level lemmas/reductions only. The common contraction rank is exactly 20, but Example 11.2.7 defines a gluing family rather than one canonical object. Route A must first discharge A0 by binding a representative or proving uniform generic vanishing before the eight Yoneda relations can decide A1. Route G weak equivariant semiregularity and G6 family coverage also remain open. HC-P04 and the full Hodge conjecture remain open.
